ASSURANCE / IDENTITY MAPPINGS

Where does each world reach?

The cross promises a world. This report shows what is deliberately shared, what is connected to identity, and where that promise remains unfinished.

Equal output never implies intentional invariance. Missing and undecided relationships remain open work.

Download the machine-readable report ↗

9Intentionally invariant58Identity mapped0Missing8Undecided

What these statuses establish

Intentionally invariant
An explicit scoped policy and reason. A declaration is not a proof over all page descendants.
Identity mapped
All four world values, the runtime data projection and the corresponding cross writer are present.
Missing
Identity variation is expected, but a value or connection is absent. An invariant declaration can also conflict with a cross writer.
Undecided
The intended relationship has not been established. Equal outputs do not resolve it.

Homepage, identity Threads and Maps, forty readings per identity, identity Questions return links, curated application collections, appearance, interaction and footer.

Declared surface inventory plus automatic discovery of unclassified top-level cross browser writers. Catalogue rows check collection facts, selected-app notes, the view/serializer pipeline and cross content writer; they do not prove every inner renderer dependency. This is not exhaustive DOM, transitive dependency, visual or semantic verification. Threads and Map route rows additionally require generated destination headings, copy, artwork, reading links and identity return navigation across all forty readings in each world. These checks do not certify semantic or visual correctness.

christian
